review_candidates.title: Network Architecture Manager
review_candidates.description_excerpt: As traffic scales globally, maintaining an agile, high-capacity, and rock-solid core mobile network infrastructure is essential to our user experience. Key Responsibilities Core Network Strategy & Mapping Audit & Topology Mapping: Deeply map and document Holafly’s current end-to-end core network layout, covering packet core components (PGW/UPF, SMF, MME/AMF), roaming interfaces (S8/N9, GRX/IPX transit), and routing paths. Quality of Service (QoS) & Routing: Optimize QoS profiles, APN configurati
eligibility_evidence: Remediation & Performance Optimization: Architect and deploy technical fixes for identified capacity bottlenecks, optimizing packet processing, session setup times, and IP routing pathways across international nodes.
Global Scale & Impact: Directly shape the connectivity experience for millions of international travelers worldwide.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Qualifications & Experience Telecom Infrastructure Background: 12+ years of experience in mobile network architecture, core network engineering (EPC/5GC), or network strategy within an MNO, MVNO, or MVNE environment. Core Network Mastery: Deep hands-on knowledge of 3GPP LTE/5G core architectures (MME, HSS, PGW, PCRF, AMF, UPF, SMF), roaming protocols (S6a, S8, GTP-C/U, Diameter, SIP), and IPX interconnects. Network Protocol Expertise: Solid understanding of IP networking protocols (BGP, OSPF, MPLS, IPsec, DNS, CGNAT) and packet analysis tools (Wireshark, tcpdump). Effective Communicator: Able to translate high-level business growth goals into concrete technical requirements, and articulate complex architectural tradeoffs to senior leadership.
